posts.title: I like when liquid glass moves
posts.description: I find skeuomorphism annoying. My 250ppi screen is the culmination of centuries of technological advancement, I don't need to have it show clock hands to make telling the time feel more "natural". So to me Apple's liquid glass is an unnecessary, temporary trend to primarily add flair for TV ads, not meaningfully improve UX. posts.title: On drawing the line
posts.description: I'm all for self-improvement. Investing the time to learn new things into adulthood has had a positive impact on my life, but everyone has a different threshold for the value add vs inconvenience. posts.title: Reminder that your AI agent is still just a GPT
posts.description: AI agents have officially fully infiltrated my development workflow.
